vulnerability.name: USN-5462-2
vulnerability.description: USN-5462-1 fixed several vulnerabilities in Ruby. This update provides the corresponding CVE-2022-28739 update for ruby2.3 on Ubuntu 16.04 ESM.  Original advisory details:  It was discovered that Ruby incorrectly handled certain inputs. An attacker could possibly use this issue to expose sensitive information.

statements.status_notes: Ruby could be made to crash or read sensitive information when processing certain input. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
